description: Compare drug spending — Compare 2-8 drugs side by side in Medicare or Medicaid: drugs= brand or generic names separated by ; or commas (e.g. Eliquis;Xarelto;warfarin), program=partd (default) | partb | medicaid. Returns latest-year spending, claims, beneficiaries, cost per claim, per unit and per beneficiary, spending and claims share, 1-year and multi-year growth and unit-cost change for each, plus highlights (highest spending, most claims, lowest and highest cost per claim, fastest growth, steepest unit-cost increase). Gross spending before rebates. Source: CMS Spending by Drug datasets, data.cms.gov (US government, public domain). Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_drug_spending_compare
